displayName: Ulta Beauty API - Search, Prices, Shades, Store Stock
description: Ulta Beauty product data as structured JSON - search ulta.com or list any category with list and sale price, discount, promo text, rating and review count, read one product with every shade or size, GTIN, ingredients, ship, pickup and same-day options and the five most recent reviews, and check in-store pickup stock of one shade at the 10 stores nearest a ZIP. 4 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
